title: Grateful Dead Live at Pershing Municipal Auditorium on 1973-02-26
lineage: S:MR > cassette > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording is generally clear and powerful, capturing a high‑energy February ’73 show highlighted by an epic Dark Star>Eyes>Half‑Step sequence and inspired Jerry Garcia solos.
ai_review.review: The SBD source delivers crisp instrument separation, though the mix lets Billy Kreutzmann’s ride dominate at times and a few tracks are missing from the archive version. Musically the concert shines with a soaring Dark Star suite, scorching China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, a monster Playing In The Band, and a blistering Big Railroad Blues; Jerry’s improvisations on Greatest Story Ever Told and the Dark Star are repeatedly praised. Overall fans consider this one of the standout Winter‑73 performances despite the occasional mix imbalance.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of detailed reviews award 4–5 stars and highlight exceptional playing, with only a few comments noting mix or missing‑song issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced SBD capture; occasional over‑emphasis on Billy Kreutzmann’s ride cymbal, some listeners note the mix could be toned down. A few songs (Deal, Mexicali) are missing from this archive version, but the existing tracks sound crisp.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Eyes of the World > Half Step
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Not Fade Away > Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans note a long, varied first set that builds momentum into an explosive second set; the Dark Star suite and high‑octane jams make the latter half especially memorable.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly described as 'extremely inspired' with standout solos on Greatest Story Ever Told and throughout the Dark Star sequence.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned missing two cues during Tennessee Jed, leading to a brief stumble before the band recovered.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for sharp rhythm guitar work and vocal contributions; noted backing acoustic encore after stage shutdown.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy Kreutzmann’s ride cymbal is mixed louder than other instruments, which some listeners find tedious over long stretches.
